title: Dagmar asks you to pick a side

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Here to do more freeloading?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here to do more freeloading?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just being neighborly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just being neighborly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah. What you got?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. What you got?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: No such thing in this place. You're either a slug or a snake. Which are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No such thing in this place. You're either a slug or a snake. Which are you?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: For you? A bit of advice. In this business you're either a slug or a snake. No inbetweens. Which are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For you? A bit of advice. In this business you're either a slug or a snake. No inbetweens. Which are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Slug.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Slug.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Snake.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Snake.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: You gonna ooze around picking up a few Lims here and there? Or you gonna go out and snatch them? Simple question. Slug or snake?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You gonna ooze around picking up a few Lims here and there? Or you gonna go out and snatch them? Simple question. Slug or snake?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Slug.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Slug.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Snake.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Snake.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Neither. Or both. I don't care.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Neither. Or both. I don't care.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Neither. Or both. I don't care.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Neither. Or both. I don't care.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: I knew it. You got that good-for-nothing look about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it. You got that good-for-nothing look about you.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: I knew it. Thought you had a bit of venom about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it. Thought you had a bit of venom about you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you asking me this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you asking me this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you asking me this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you asking me this?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Because if you're a snake then maybe we can talk about the restaurant biz. If you're a slug, I'm gonna have to crush you under size eight heels.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because if you're a snake then maybe we can talk about the restaurant biz. If you're a slug, I'm gonna have to crush you under size eight heels.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then let's talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then let's talk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd like to see you try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd like to see you try.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd like to see you try.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd like to see you try.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Fact is this: Thaddeus was a slug. That noodle bar was never gonna be a threat to my empire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fact is this: Thaddeus was a slug. That noodle bar was never gonna be a threat to my empire.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Like one of the other restaurants in the LUZ. I've run the numbers. It's you, or someone else. Anything else threatens my profit margin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like one of the other restaurants in the LUZ. I've run the numbers. It's you, or someone else. Anything else threatens my profit margin.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want me to take down one of the other businesses?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want me to take down one of the other businesses?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want me to take down one of the other businesses?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want me to take down one of the other businesses?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: That's about the measure of it, yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's about the measure of it, yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's in it for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No way.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: I'll recommend you to some of my more... discerning clientele.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll recommend you to some of my more... discerning clientele.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think we can do business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think we can do business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think we can do business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think we can do business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Forget it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Forget it.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Well, it's your repossession notice. Don't say I didn't give you a chance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, it's your repossession notice. Don't say I didn't give you a chance.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Excellent. Let's start easy. A little drop and run at a rival's joint. Leave this dead rodent somewhere a customer is sure to see it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excellent. Let's start easy. A little drop and run at a rival's joint. Leave this dead rodent somewhere a customer is sure to see it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you just... carry dead rats on you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you just... carry dead rats on you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you just... carry dead rats on you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you just... carry dead rats on you?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Never know when a bit of sabotage might be necessary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never know when a bit of sabotage might be necessary.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: I hope so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Makes sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Good. Because you're about to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. Because you're about to.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: If you're ambitious, well... Something's gonna have to give.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're ambitious, well... Something's gonna have to give.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not Thaddeus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not Thaddeus.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that a threat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that a threat?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fearing the competition makes you a slug.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fearing the competition makes you a slug.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fearing the competition makes you a slug.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fearing the competition makes you a slug.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Not fighting the competition as long as it's weak is idiocy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not fighting the competition as long as it's weak is idiocy.
